claim: Bulk-tissue RNA (HPA 'RNA expression (HPA)' product, 40 tissues -- not the separate 51-tissue 'consensus' product) shows CEACAM5 predominantly enriched in GI tissues (colon 920.3, rectum 885.1, appendix 175.2, stomach 154.1, esophagus 148.8 nTPM), with additional non-GI RNA signal requiring follow-up: lung 28.5 nTPM (above small intestine's 23.2) and tonsil 34.6, smooth muscle 26.8 nTPM. See TE003 (HPA IHC) for the cell-type-resolved follow-up on lung specifically. Liver/heart/kidney/bone marrow all <1 nTPM.
notes: Bulk RNA only -- does not by itself confine the signal to GI tissue (see TE003 for the IHC evidence that actually resolves the lung/tonsil/smooth-muscle RNA signal). indication_id is this repository's territory for the matched primary/CRLM cohorts this normal-tissue reference is paired against (Module B, same target, currently BLOCKED); the source data itself (HPA) is not mCRC-patient-specific -- see adc_decision_axis=normal_tissue_risk, a cross-patient reference axis.

claim: GTEx v11 median TPM (68 tissues) is consistent with enrichment in mucosa-containing/epithelial-enriched samples: Colon_Transverse_Mucosa 1069.6 vs Colon_Transverse_Muscularis 75.4 (>10x), Esophagus_Mucosa 277.8 vs Esophagus_Muscularis 0.14 (>1000x). Liver/heart/kidney all <0.1 median TPM; GTEx v11 has no bone marrow tissue.
notes: REFERENCE_SUPPORT tier per module_classification.tsv -- catches normal-organ signal HPA might miss, cannot alone establish a safety conclusion. nTPM (HPA, TE001) and median_TPM (GTEx, this row) are not directly comparable across rows; each source's pattern is read within itself, not cross-normalized.

claim: HPA cell-type-resolved normal-tissue IHC (109 tissue/cell-type rows for CEACAM5) is High only in Appendix/Colon/Rectum enterocytes (incl. microvilli), endocrine cells and goblet cells (12 rows), and Medium only in mucosal lymphoid cells (Colon/Rectum), squamous epithelial cells (Esophagus/Oral mucosa), and glandular cells (Stomach) (6 rows). Every other scored cell type, including lung alveolar cells type I and type II (both Low), bone marrow hematopoietic cells (Low), tonsil and smooth muscle (not scored High/Medium anywhere), is Low or Not detected. This resolves TE001's flagged lung/tonsil/smooth-muscle RNA signal: it does not correspond to a High/Medium protein signal in any HPA-scored cell type in those tissues.
